summary_en: Year-end dividend per share raised from 75 yen to 82 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, bringing annual dividend to 72 yen and consolidated dividend payout ratio to 40.8%, based on upwardly revised earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Hachijuni Nagano Bank has raised its year-end dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, from 35 yen per share to 42 yen per share. This adjustment increases the total annual dividend from the previously forecasted 65 yen to 72 yen per share. The revision reflects upwardly adjusted consolidated and standalone earnings forecasts, with operating profit forecast raised from 106.0 billion yen to 119.0 billion yen and net income from 73.0 billion yen to 80.0 billion yen.

The dividend increase aligns with the bank's capital allocation policy under its first medium-term management plan, which targets a consolidated dividend payout ratio of 40% or higher. Based on the revised earnings, the consolidated dividend payout ratio for fiscal 2027 is now projected at 40.8%. The bank attributed the earnings upgrade to better-than-expected performance in fund profit and gains on securities for the half-year ended September 2026 and recent business trends.
